title: MT82 manual transmission component map
introduction:
These views identify components on the MT82 manual transmission. I orient each drawing by the wide bellhousing at the engine end and the output flange at the driveline end. The views look from different sides, so those landmarks swap sides on the page.

Match each callout to the table immediately beneath its own drawing. The numbering restarts and changes meaning between views; carrying a callout across to the other table would give you the wrong component. The solid-case view locates upper-case fittings, the wired switch and external fasteners. The partly transparent view reveals components around and inside the bellhousing as well as the fill and drain locations.

The clutch slave cylinder uses hydraulic pressure to operate the clutch release mechanism. OSS means output shaft speed, identifying the speed sensor’s role. The purple highlighting includes both fluid plugs and fasteners supporting internal parts, so color alone is no invitation to put a wrench on something. I use the callout and its description together.

This reference completes component identification. The transparent housing does not show an in-car access route, and the drawings do not supply removal steps, electrical tests, fluid specifications, torque values or a filling procedure.
